title: Original RAX articulated model and point clouds, adapted as an automatic offline animation
geometry_or_model_changes: None. Original recorded point clouds, measured model parameters, fitted rim, action poses and initial camera viewpoint retained.
packaging_changes: Convert ES module transport into isolated classic scripts and embed JSON for file://
Remove the complete slider/checkbox/button sidebar and drag hint; no manual orbit or zoom controller is bundled
Use a full-width white canvas with original point-cloud/model/action labels
Replace the one-shot opening with a smooth repeating 14-second cycle: 2 seconds closed, 4 seconds opening, 4 seconds open, 4 seconds closing
Use a gentle automatic camera orbit of +/-0.18 radians around the initial view over 42 seconds
Advance drawer and camera from the same active-time clock; hidden slides freeze and resume without wall-time jumps
Reduced-motion preference shows a static open model with planned hand poses
measurement_note: The measured opening is approximately131mm (13.1cm); the exact original value is retained. The drawer model moves continuously, while point clouds switch between two recorded closed/open scans at the original threshold. Planned poses appear near the measured maximum opening.

verification.cycle_test: Actual state machine exercised with accelerated requestAnimationFrame timestamps; no seek or animation API changes
